dedupe_keys.name: zones inondables en dehors des zones reglementaires des ppri

description: Zones inondables en dehors des zones réglementaires des PPRI is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction Départementale des Territoires du Bas-Rhin (67). Cover areas of all known floods, either by modeling or by field observation. Coverage: Direction Départementale des Territoires du Bas-Rhin (67). The portal shows the English title as "Floodable areas outside the regulatory areas of the MIPs" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direction Départementale des Territoires du Bas-Rhin (67). Its keywords include bas-rhin, crues, inondable, ppri. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2015-11-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
